Subject: NebulaPay implementation sequencing & mutual action plan (MAP)

Hi Aisha / NebulaPay team —

Thanks again for the product walkthrough yesterday. Per our conversation I put together a starter mutual action plan (attached) that outlines the core milestones, owners, and proposed dates so we can align expectations before the kickoff. High level: 

- Week 0 (prep): contract & security clearance, account provisioning, SSO details collected (Procurement + Security).
- Week 1: Kickoff & discovery (tech deep-dive, data schema, success metrics). Owner: Marissa (CS).
- Weeks 2–4: Integration sprints (API keys, sample ingestion, batching config). Owner: Ben (SRE).
- Week 5: Acceptance testing & go/no-go decision; small-scale pilot traffic.
- Week 6–8: Ramp to production and post-launch review.

Critical asks for the kickoff: procurement point of contact for SOW sign & billing, security questionnaire completion (I attached our SOC2 summary), and an internal list of sandbox API owners. Can procurement loop in the appropriate person?

I attached: mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx (MAP) and redwood-soc2-summary.pdf. I also added a working Drive folder (link below) that we will keep updated.

Proposed kickoff: Thu Jul 22, 10:00–11:00 PT. If that works we will send a calendar invite and a short pre-read.

Next steps: 
- Aisha / Procurement: confirm kickoff date and provide procurement contact.
- Marissa / Ben (cc): review MAP and flag any resource or date conflicts by EOD Monday so we can adjust.

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber

Subject: Internal: NebulaPay MAP — owners & pre-kick checklist

Marissa / Ben — looping you both to confirm owners and the prep checklist after Aisha's reply (below). Please keep internal notes here; Aisha should only see the high-level owners and dates (she's cc'd).

Summary of owners I propose: 
- Marissa Cole: overall CS lead & kickoff facilitator; run discovery, success metric alignment, and acceptance criteria.
- Ben Carter: SRE/integration lead; responsible for API onboarding, key rotation policy, batching/throughput tuning, and pilot ops.

Pre-kick checklist (please action by Mon Jul 19 EOD):
1) Marissa — draft kickoff deck (15–20 min) with discovery questions and success metrics; place in Drive folder.
2) Ben — prepare a short integration playbook (API endpoints, auth, rate limits, expected payloads) and a minimal test harness for NebulaPay to try.
3) Jonas — draft SOW bullet list for procurement to convert into a contract; I will also attach the HubSpot deal link for reference.
4) Marissa/Ben — review MAP dates and flag any impossible windows. Note: NebulaPay flagged a compliance freeze Aug 16–Aug 20; we should aim for pilot acceptance before Aug 16.

Proposed timeline (we can tighten if needed):
- Jul 22: Kickoff + discovery (Marissa)
- Jul 23–Aug 6: Integration sprints (Ben lead; three 1-week sprints of work + testing)
- Aug 9–13: Pilot acceptance testing
- Aug 16: Target production ramp (avoid; compliance freeze — aim to complete before)

Ben/Marissa — are you OK with the resource estimates? If you have calendar conflicts I can reassign or push dates.

Jonas (for context the HubSpot deal id is 5201-NEB-2026-042; I'll put the SOW bullets in the Drive folder tonight).

—Jonas
